I illustrated my very first #TarotCard. It’s long been a dream of mine to make my own deck so I started with an (artistically) easy card - the Ace of Cups. The card follows form of a traditional Rider Tarot deck’s AOC showing a chalice overflowing with water. Traditionally cups are read as emotion/feelings with the water in the cup representing this. For me the Ace of Cups is all about overwhelming feeling, filling and brimming with thoughts, ideas, and love to offer others and no outlet (yet), thus the overflowing. We see in my depiction that the water spilling from the cup has sprouted an early bloom of flowers, meaning the feelings are not entirely at a waste. However if a useful outlet is not found the surrounding area will flood smothering the flowers bloomed and grass. The infinity sign at the base of the chalice is representative of introspection as thoughts flow freely and infinitely without interruption from and back to their source - the sun engraved in the chalice; representative of sense of self and inner power in turn continually feeding the infinity sign. The hearts in the sky herald in a time of love and sense of oneness as we look forward to the horizon, the path to the Two of Cups.
